formal.compatibility_read_boundary: only approved legacy sources may be read during a separately authorized migration; never write back to legacy

preview.compatibility_read_boundary: isolated workstation Preview root; no formal or legacy import by default, and any explicit import must land in a newly created Preview root

stable.compatibility_read_boundary: 1.6.x Stable reuses the existing Workstation Preview data root under an exclusive data-root lease; no copy, migration, clear, or overwrite is performed

legacy_read_only.compatibility_read_boundary: read-only compatibility source; no runtime start, write, migration, deletion, overwrite, or lock-file update
